packageRules.description: Everything except the Kit stack: detect and list on the Dependency Dashboard, open a PR only when ticked there
Moved by the ports (.github/upstream-port.md) together with gpui-kit or gpui-kit-material
The browser and web consumers take their Kit from gpui-kit-material; the gpui-kit-material port moves it
Kit and Material releases: one PR each on a fixed branch, which upstream-port.yml hands to Claude Code
prBodyNotes: The **Upstream port** workflow ports this release with Claude Code and pushes the result here. When every check passes it labels the PR `port-ready`; **Upstream land** then merges it once CI is green, and a Kit release is tagged and published.
